title: Bob's Mansion
description:
Bob's Mansion is an immersive first-person horror game that takes you on a thrilling journey through the dark eerie remnants of your old family home. Take the role of Mike Jingle. A 22 year old guy, who one day receives a letter asking him to return to his family home. Now you return home to find your family missing. Use your Parkour skills to search the darkness and uncover the secrets that lurk within. Are you brave enough to face the unknown? 

 Key Features• Run, walk, climb and slide your way through the dark environment. 

• Hide against unstoppable creatures.

• Fight monstrous enemies with a unique prototype weapon.

• Survive and explore the mansion and uncover the secrets beneath. 

• Random Item Placement and Permadeath mode.

 

 Bob's Mansion is an chapter based horror game. The story is revealed via cutscenes, environmental storytelling and secret notes. Are you brave enough to face the Darkness Inside?
description_short: Bob's Mansion is a First-Person, Survival Horror, Adventure game where you use your skills to Run, Hide, Fight and Survive the darkness within your family home.
